explication: Organic Maps is a privacy-focused offline maps and GPS application. Its principal workflow starts with a traveler viewing locally available map data, then searching for places or planning a route and receiving turn-by-turn guidance. The README also documents bookmarks and track exchange, map downloads, transit, elevation, and place information. The graph combines those documented product capabilities with the Android/native and core-library boundaries visible in the source index; several feature links are omitted where implementation excerpts were unavailable.
